Supplied current sources I1, I2, I3, and L1 each have an identity, date, scope, and SHA-256; they support equipment-diagnosis goals, noisy-plant constraints, concise communication, and a confidence variable bounded 0..1 that rises 0.1 only after verified evidence. Raw quotes are prohibited.

supplied: four current source identities and digests
packaged schema, validator, canonicalizer, and new local output identities

cases.oracle: Emits a schema-valid, semantically valid, source-linked persona plus JCS digest and validation receipt without executing a consumer.

cases.oracle: Returns GAP, rejects unsupported false specificity, and offers only a minimal explicitly synthetic hypothesis after a permitted purpose and hypothesis source are supplied.
